jev_system_1_evaluator.purpose: Rapid evaluation of queries against reflexes to provide tentative verdicts for BioCore task automation

cell_type.instructions: Which cell type (mutation) should handle this reflex?
options: sensory - Web scraping, URL data extraction

persistence_required.instructions: Must data be stored in database? (Look for: guardala, guardalo, save, store, db_insert, almacenala)

automation_readiness.instructions: Is the instruction clear and actionable?
automation_readiness.true: Specific cell type, clear sequence, defined endpoint

scale: Medium: Clear intent but some ambiguity in implementation
High: Explicit task and defined sequence

tentative_verdict.instructions: What should happen with this reflex?
options: queue - Valid but needs user confirmation
review - Needs human approval before automation

test_1_scrape_and_store.task_summary: scrapea esta URL y guardala en la base de datos

test_2_file_read_only.reasoning: Missing file path - cannot execute without additional context

test_3_git_workflow.task_summary: haz commit y push de los cambios

test_4_ambiguous_request.reasoning: Source is ambiguous - file? database? Could be filesystem->read_file OR memory->db_query. Needs clarification.

jev_reasoning_example.input_query: scrapea esta URL y guardala en la base de datos

jev_thinking.step_2: Keywords: URL extraction + database storage = sensory + memory cells
jev_thinking.step_4: Automation ready? Yes - explicit and complete
jev_thinking.conclusion: EXECUTE - Perfect match with reflex pattern
